>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}/compare"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Compares the goal verdicts of this campaign run with those of another visible campaign run (`baseline`, required), matching goals by their text: each goal is `regressed` (now jailbroken), `fixed`, `unchanged`, `new` or `dropped`, with the totals. Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
